publication.title: FacetOntology: Expressive Descriptions of Facets in the Semantic Web

adjudication.basis: FacetOntology links RDF/SPARQL facet definitions and an interactive Data Picker to concrete generated mSpace/Exhibit browsers across multiple domains. It is not solely an ontology specification or disconnected backend.

codes.notes: FacetOntology has multiple rendering backends; RDF input does not mean native RDF in final mSpace. Hypothetical1,000-item migration not actual benchmark. Automatic ranking is future.

descriptions.interaction: Data Picker browses classes, predicate paths and sample values, previews selected facets; generated browsers permit iterative facet filtering and multiple entity-type exploration.
descriptions.guidance: Human-readable bounded facet models, predicate chains including inverse direction, datatype/literal handling, contextual values and reusable configurable facet definitions. Automatic ranking is discussed as future assistance, not implemented proof.
descriptions.visualisation: Generated Exhibit/mSpace faceted result views, date-picker and contextual metadata; Data Picker preview.
descriptions.backend: RDF facet definitions, SPARQL harvesting/query hints and repeatable transformations; Exhibit JSON client file or mSpace relational server database with per-facet tables and joins.
descriptions.evaluation: Four exemplar deployments / maker capability demonstration

resources.notes: README names facetontology-exhibit and states it creates Exhibits from FacetOntology definitions.

report_level_evaluation.design: Four exemplar deployments / maker capability demonstration
report_level_evaluation.comparators: Same BBC iPlayer facets rendered by two frameworks; no controlled usability study
report_level_evaluation.results: Demonstrates Francophone Music Criticism, Rich Tags, BBC iPlayer and UsabilityUK functionality. No measured user benefit or runtime reported.
